A stormy mountain pass choked with soldiers and broken supply wagons, lightning splitting the peaks above, avalanche dust mixing with battle-smoke, torches guttering in the gale below.

A great city ablaze at night, street-fires merging into walls of orange flame, panicked figures silhouetted against crumbling buildings, smoke columns blotting the stars, distant siege-engines hurling fire.
A snow-field churned to black mud and ash, two armies colliding in the grey middle-distance, burning war-machines sinking into the slush, blizzard and smoke merging at the horizon.

A desert siege under a white-hot sun, sand-colored walls blackened by Greek-fire, catapult stones arcing through haze, armies of thousands casting short shadows, dust and smoke merging into a choking amber pall.
A forest fortress half-consumed by flame, ancient trees torching like pillars of fire, defenders retreating along burning walkways, attackers surging through the smoldering undergrowth far below.

A clifftop keep hammered by a thunderstorm, lightning illuminating crumbling battlements, waves crashing the rocks far below, torchlight and muzzle-flash flickering through curtains of rain and smoke.
A wide river-crossing choked with soldiers and capsized barges, the near bank ablaze, archers firing from burning docks, bodies and wreckage spinning in the current, smoke hanging low on the water.

A volcanic battlefield, rivers of lava cutting glowing channels between warring armies, ash raining from a towering eruption-cloud, war-banners catching fire, the whole plain lit in hellish red and orange.
A siege of a massive walled city at golden dusk, battering-rams at the gates, burning pitch poured from the parapets, the vast besieging camp stretching to the smoke-hazed horizon behind.

A highland fortress in autumn, forested slopes below already burning, defenders hurling boulders from smoke-stained towers, opposing cavalry streaming across flame-lit meadows, dark storm-clouds pressing down from above.
A frozen lake battlefield cracking underfoot, soldiers slipping on ice stained red, bonfires lit by both sides for warmth now spreading out of control, smoke rising into a steel-grey dawn sky.

A sunken Roman-style arena repurposed as a last-stand fortification, outer walls breached and burning, defenders clustered at the central keep, siege-ladders silhouetted against a smoke-filled sky, fire everywhere.
A jungle river-fort at dawn, bamboo palisades eaten by flame, war-canoes burning on the brown water, tropical trees torching in a wall of green-then-orange fire, smoke smothering the rising sun.
A crumbling aqueduct spanning a burning valley, soldiers fighting for control of its spine, one end collapsed into flame, catapult stones arcing overhead, the ruined city below fully ablaze.

A mine-shaft siege at dusk, collapse craters pitting the foreground, sappers and defenders fighting at the smoking breach, the besieged town's timber rooftops catching fire, a lurid sunset behind the chaos.

A tundra fortress at polar twilight, aurora and flame competing overhead, ice-sheathed walls darkened by soot, war-elephants and soldiers tiny against the vast frozen plain, bonfires ringing the siege in a necklace of fire.

A clifftop lighthouse-fort in a sea-storm, the great beam still turning through smoke and spray, enemy ships burning on the reefs below, defenders fighting on rain-lashed stairs, waves exploding against the rocks.

A grand bridge-fortress spanning a gorge, the bridge deck on fire, soldiers clashing in silhouette against the orange chasm below, catapult arms swinging on both banks, smoke funneled upward by the ravine.
